name: Real-time Feedback
description: Sends real-time execution feedback (text + emoji) to channels during agent task processing, so users don't have to wait for the final result.

enabled.label: Enable Feedback
enabled.help: Send real-time feedback messages during agent execution.

locale.label: Language
locale.help: Display language for feedback messages (zh or en).

debounceMs.label: Debounce (ms)
debounceMs.help: Minimum interval between feedback messages per run.

feishuCards.label: Feishu Cards
feishuCards.help: Use Feishu interactive cards instead of plain text (future).
